jobs.label: Anti-missile / anti-drone Humvee
jobs.description: Recognizable compact olive-drab four-wheel Humvee: wide square hood NORTH/front, low four-door crew cab roof and dark narrow windshield top line in the center, open rear cargo bed SOUTH/back. Four narrow knobby tire top bands, two per side. The rear cargo bed has a lightweight swiveling rocket turret with TWO small pods of THREE slender launcher tubes each, six tubes total, aimed north above the cab roof, all nearly horizontal. A tiny central optical-sensor box between pods, exterior only. Deliberately a compact game interceptor vehicle for anti-drone and anti-missile rockets, no large tank turret, no sci-fi laser, no upward-pointing pipes or visible driver faces.
jobs.prompt: Use case: image-edit. Correct the rear rocket turret in ALL FOUR cells. Keep Humvee hood NORTH, cargo bed SOUTH, fixed overhead chassis. Replace the backward/upward-facing tubes with TWO pods of exactly THREE parallel horizontal narrow launcher tubes each, SIX total. All SIX long tubes run SOUTH-to-NORTH, mounted in rear bed and extending toward/over the cab. Their open firing mouths are at NORTH tips, only tiny thin edge-on rim slivers from a straight-down camera; the SOUTH ends are CLOSED tail caps. No large circular black bores visible on top or at south. The pods must visibly aim forward over the cab toward the top of each cell. Preserve four subtle sensor/antenna idle poses, realistic painted olive surface, fixed dimensions and wide transparent gutters.
